## What We Do

Filters For You is Sydney's water filtration service. Founded by Jean-Paul Barbar, NSW Licensed Plumber #461511C, it supplies, installs and services whole house water filtration, under sink reverse osmosis systems and inline drinking water filtration in homes right across Sydney. A licensed plumber installs every system. Every installed price is published, and so is what it costs to look after each system every year. The lifetime warranty comes with the Filtered for Life plan, our yearly care plan.

Sydney's water is safe, but it is not pure. Sydney Water treats for the city. We purify for your home.

## Products & Pricing (supply and installation, GST included)

- Pure Flow, Three in One Inline Filtration: $760
- Pure Essential, 4 Stage Neutralising Reverse Osmosis: $1,090
- Pure Premium, 7 Stage Hydrogen Rich Alkaline Reverse Osmosis: $1,490
- Pure Luxe, Smart 5 Stage Alkaline Reverse Osmosis: $1,990
- Pure Home, 3 Stage Whole House Filtration: from $2,950
- Pure Home Reserve, Deluxe Whole House Filtration System in a lockable stainless cabinet: from $4,150
- Deluxe Home package, Pure Home plus Pure Essential plus a free Classic three way mixer: $4,040
- Deluxe Home Reserve package, Pure Home Reserve plus Pure Premium plus a free Classic three way mixer, with the first year of servicing free on both systems: $5,640
- Undersink chiller, an add on that chills filtered water on its way to the tap, around 10 degrees, about eight glasses ready to pour: $1,050 installed with Pure Essential, Pure Premium or Pure Luxe

Whole house prices start from the figure shown. The price for your home is confirmed in writing before we start.

The Classic three way mixer is one gooseneck tap for hot, cold and purified water, in brushed gold, stainless steel, gunmetal or matte black, with a 25 year maker's warranty. It is free in both Deluxe packages and $480 on its own.

## Yearly Care (per system, each year, GST included)

Every system has three yearly options. Billed yearly, in one payment at the service. No monthly billing and no contract.

- DIY kit: the year's cartridges posted to you. You change them yourself, no visit. The manufacturer's parts warranty applies. No lifetime warranty.
- Yearly service: we come to you once a year, change the cartridges and check the system.
- Filtered for Life plan: the same yearly service, plus the lifetime warranty on parts, labour and call outs for as long as you stay on the plan, plus the member perks below.

Prices, DIY kit / yearly service / Filtered for Life plan:

- Pure Flow: $140 / $310 / $380
- Pure Essential: $150 / $310 / $550
- Pure Premium: $250 / $390 / $650
- Pure Luxe: $270 / $420 / $650
- Pure Home and Pure Home Reserve: $390 / $550 / $700
- Deluxe Home package: $540 / $760 / $1,150
- Deluxe Home Reserve package: $640 / $840 / $1,250, with the first year of servicing free on both systems

## The Filtered for Life Plan

What a member gets:

- The yearly service: cartridges changed and the system checked, every year.
- The lifetime warranty: every part of the system we supply and install is covered for life, with the labour and call outs included, for as long as you stay on the plan. You never pay for a covered repair. A leak or no water gets its own visit. Any other covered fault is fixed at the next yearly service, at no charge. Cartridges are part of the yearly service.
- Filtered for Free, the referral programme, open to every customer: for every friend you refer who installs Pure Essential or above, your next year of cartridges is free. On the DIY kit that year costs $0. On the yearly service or the Filtered for Life plan you pay $190 for the visit only, and a member keeps the lifetime warranty. No limit, never paid as cash.
- Discounted plumbing maintenance for your home.
- Every 5th year on the plan at half price (year 5, 10, 15 and so on).

Every new install is covered from install day until its first yearly service, when the customer chooses. Leaving the plan ends the lifetime warranty for good. Mixer taps carry their maker's own tapware warranty, and a Pure Flow customer's own kitchen mixer is not part of the cover. Pure Luxe smart electronics are covered in full for 5 years from installation, then a fixed $600 contribution to a replacement system. The full terms are at https://filtersforyou.com.au/lifetime-warranty. The Australian Consumer Law guarantees always apply.

Without the plan, every install still carries the manufacturer's parts warranty and our lifetime promise on our own workmanship: if the work was not done right, we come back and fix it free.

## Two Systems at One Address

- The second system is $200 off its install, for each extra system. This does not apply to the Deluxe packages, which are already priced as packages. Taps are never discounted.
- The cheaper system's yearly service, or its Filtered for Life plan, is $100 off, because one visit covers both.
- DIY kits have no two system discount.

### ABOUT FILTERS FOR YOU

Q: Who is Filters For You?
A: Filters For You is Sydney's water filtration service, run by Jean-Paul Barbar, an NSW Licensed Plumber (#461511C) based in Croydon Park. Every system is installed by a licensed plumber. Every installed price and every yearly care price is published. The lifetime warranty comes with the Filtered for Life plan. Rated 5.0 from 33 Google reviews, every one five stars (as at 19 October 2026).

Q: Who is Jean-Paul Barbar?
A: Jean-Paul Barbar is the licensed plumber and founder of Filters For You. He holds NSW Plumbing Licence #461511C, verifiable at NSW Fair Trading. He founded Tapped Out Plumbing, then launched Filters For You in 2023 to focus on water filtration for Sydney homes. He is based in Croydon Park, Sydney NSW 2133. He is an authorised Filter Systems Australia and High Performance Filtration installer, listed on the FSA installer finder.

Q: Is Filters For You a licensed plumbing company?
A: Yes. Filters For You is operated by Jean-Paul Barbar, an NSW licensed plumber (Licence #461511C). The licence can be checked at fair.trading.nsw.gov.au. Jean-Paul carries public liability insurance.

Q: Where is Filters For You based?
A: Filters For You is based in Croydon Park, Sydney NSW 2133, and installs right across Sydney: the Inner West, Inner City and CBD, Eastern Suburbs, North Shore, Northern Beaches, Forest District, Hills District, St George, Sutherland Shire, South Sydney, Canterbury-Bankstown, South West Sydney and Greater Western Sydney. Call 0430 546 749 to confirm your suburb.

Q: Who installs the system?
A: A licensed plumber installs every system, and Filters For You comes back every year to service it. Call 0430 546 749 to book.

Q: How long has Jean-Paul been a plumber?
A: Jean-Paul founded Tapped Out Plumbing before launching Filters For You in 2023, a business focused on water filtration. He holds a current NSW Plumbing Licence (#461511C) and has installed water filtration systems in homes across Sydney.

Q: Is Filters For You insured?
A: Yes. Jean-Paul carries public liability insurance for all water filter installation work.

### PRICING & VALUE

Q: How much does water filter installation cost in Sydney?
A: Every price includes supply, installation by a licensed plumber and GST. Pure Flow inline filtration is $760. Reverse osmosis starts at $1,090 for the 4 stage Pure Essential, then $1,490 for the 7 stage hydrogen rich Pure Premium and $1,990 for the smart Pure Luxe. Whole house filtration at the mains is from $2,950 for Pure Home and from $4,150 for Pure Home Reserve. The Deluxe Home package is $4,040 and the Deluxe Home Reserve package is $5,640. Your price is in writing before we start. Prices as at October 2026.

Q: What is included in the water filter installation price?
A: The system with its first set of cartridges, all fittings, installation by Jean-Paul Barbar (NSW Lic. 461511C), the filtered tap where the system comes with one, testing, and a full walkthrough of how it works. Every under sink reverse osmosis system gets a leak valve and a pressure limiting valve. Pure Luxe gets the pressure limiting valve and has its own leak shut off. GST included. Every install carries the manufacturer's parts warranty and our lifetime promise on our own workmanship. The lifetime warranty on parts, labour and call outs comes with the Filtered for Life plan.

Q: Is there a call-out fee for water filter installation?
A: No. The installed price covers supply, installation, the walkthrough and GST, and your price is in writing before we start.

Q: What are the ongoing costs after installation?
A: Every system has three yearly options: a DIY cartridge kit, a yearly service, or the Filtered for Life plan, which adds the lifetime warranty. Pure Flow is $140, $310 or $380 a year. Pure Essential $150, $310 or $550. Pure Premium $250, $390 or $650. Pure Luxe $270, $420 or $650. Pure Home and Pure Home Reserve $390, $550 or $700. Billed yearly, no contract. Prices as at October 2026.

Q: Is a water filter worth the cost in Sydney?
A: If a family of four bought bottled spring water for all the water they drink in a year, it would come to about $4,470. Pure Essential is $1,090 installed, then from $150 a year for the DIY kit. Pure Premium gives the family hydrogen rich alkaline water on tap for $1,490 installed and from $250 a year after that.

Q: Why is a Filters For You price not the cheapest quote?
A: Every Filters For You price includes the system, installation by a licensed plumber and GST, with the yearly care price published beside it, so you know what the system costs to run before you buy. We're not the cheapest. We're the ones still here in ten years.

Q: What does it cost to install two systems at one address?
A: The second system is $200 off its install, and the cheaper system's yearly service or Filtered for Life plan is $100 off each year, because one visit covers both. DIY kits and taps are not discounted. The Deluxe packages are priced as packages, so the $200 does not apply to them.

Q: What are the Deluxe packages?
A: Deluxe Home is Pure Home at the mains, Pure Essential under the kitchen sink and a free Classic three way mixer, for $4,040. Deluxe Home Reserve is Pure Home Reserve in your choice of colour, Pure Premium under the sink, a free Classic three way mixer and the first year of servicing free on both systems, for $5,640. Every tap and shower filtered, and purified water to drink.

Q: Can I pay for a system over time?
A: Yes. You can spread the cost with humm. See https://filtersforyou.com.au/humm or call 0430 546 749.

### INSTALLATION PROCESS

Q: How long does water filter installation take?
A: Under sink systems are fitted in about two hours. Whole house time depends on the meter and the pipework, and Jean-Paul confirms the scope before installation.

Q: Do I need a licensed plumber to install a water filter in NSW?
A: Yes. In NSW, connecting a water filter to the mains water supply, under the sink or at the meter, is plumbing work and needs a licensed plumber. Jean-Paul holds NSW Plumbing Licence #461511C.

Q: What do I need to prepare before Jean-Paul arrives?
A: Clear the cabinet under the kitchen sink so Jean-Paul has easy access. For whole house installations, make sure the water meter area is clear. Jean-Paul brings the system, the fittings, the adapters and the tools.

Q: What happens during a water filter installation?
A: Jean-Paul arrives at the agreed time with everything needed. He confirms the system location, installs the system, connects the water supply, tests for leaks and flushes the new cartridges. Whole house systems are pressure tested before he leaves. He then walks you through how the system works and what the yearly care looks like. Done in a single visit.

Q: Do I need to be home during installation?
A: Yes. An adult needs to be home to give access, confirm where the system goes and take the walkthrough at the end. The water supply is briefly turned off at the start of the install.

Q: How quickly can Jean-Paul schedule an installation?
A: Most installations are scheduled within 3 to 5 business days of enquiry. Call 0430 546 749 to check current availability.

Q: Does Jean-Paul offer same-day water filter installation?
A: Sometimes, depending on his schedule. Call 0430 546 749 directly to check.

---

### PRODUCTS & SYSTEMS

Q: What water filter systems does Filters For You install?
A: Six systems and two packages. Pure Flow, Three in One Inline Filtration, $760. Pure Essential, 4 Stage Neutralising Reverse Osmosis, $1,090. Pure Premium, 7 Stage Hydrogen Rich Alkaline Reverse Osmosis, $1,490. Pure Luxe, Smart 5 Stage Alkaline Reverse Osmosis, $1,990. Pure Home, 3 Stage Whole House Filtration, from $2,950. Pure Home Reserve, Deluxe Whole House Filtration System, from $4,150. The Deluxe Home package is $4,040 and the Deluxe Home Reserve package is $5,640. Prices include supply, installation and GST.

Q: What is Pure Flow?
A: Pure Flow is Three in One Inline Filtration, $760 installed. One quick change 0.5 micron carbon block cartridge connects to the cold water line under your sink, so your kitchen mixer stays exactly where it is. Three in one: particle filtration, and it helps reduce chlorine taste and odour in the cold water at your mixer. No new tap and no tank. One cartridge change a year.

Q: What is Pure Essential?
A: Pure Essential is 4 Stage Neutralising Reverse Osmosis, $1,090 installed. Four stages: 5 micron sediment, coconut carbon, a 0.0001 micron membrane, then a calcium and carbon finish. The membrane helps remove up to 99% of dissolved contaminants, then calcium goes back in for a neutral finish designed for about pH 7 to 8. A chrome filtered tap and a storage tank are included. Fitted under your kitchen sink in about two hours.

Q: What is Pure Premium?
A: Pure Premium is 7 Stage Hydrogen Rich Alkaline Reverse Osmosis, $1,490 installed, our bestseller and our highest specification under the sink. Seven stages: sediment, carbon, a 0.0001 micron membrane, hydrogen and minerals, ceramic, a carbon polish and an inline conditioner. The membrane helps remove up to 99% of dissolved contaminants. After it, a mineral stage adds magnesium and potassium, raises alkalinity and introduces dissolved hydrogen. A chrome filtered tap and a storage tank are included. Hydrogen rich alkaline water on tap.

Q: What is Pure Luxe?
A: Pure Luxe is Smart 5 Stage Alkaline Reverse Osmosis, $1,990 installed. Five stages in quick change cartridges, in one compact sealed case: 1 micron sediment, two carbon stages, a 0.0001 micron membrane, then an alkaline finish where calcite puts calcium back and lifts the pH to about 7 to 8. It comes with a filtered tap, a booster pump and a leak sensor. A display shows how pure your water is, live, and tells you when a filter is due.

Q: What is Pure Home?
A: Pure Home is 3 Stage Whole House Filtration, from $2,950 installed. It is fitted at your water meter, so the kitchen, every shower and bath, the laundry and the hot water system all get filtered water. Three full size cartridges: grooved sediment, a coconut carbon block, then a five stage carbon cartridge. Filtered down to 0.22 micron. The two carbon stages help reduce chlorine and chloramine in the hot and the cold, at every tap and shower, as published by the manufacturer. It is a chemical reduction system, not a softener, so the calcium and magnesium in your water stay in. Pressure tested before we leave.

Q: What is Pure Home Reserve?
A: Pure Home Reserve is our Deluxe Whole House Filtration System, from $4,150 installed. The same whole house filtration, filtered down to 0.22 micron through three cartridges and nine stages, helping reduce chlorine and chloramine at every tap and shower, as published by the manufacturer, with the minerals kept in. It sits in a 35 kg lockable stainless steel cabinet, powder coated with a UV stable finish, with a key lock front panel and a pressure gauge on every stage. 22 colours to match your home, custom colours on request. Freestanding, on the wall or in the frame. A 10 year manufacturer warranty on the system.

Q: What is the difference between Pure Home and Pure Home Reserve?
A: The filtration is the same: three stages at the mains, filtered down to 0.22 micron. Pure Home is open, on a wall bracket, in black, from $2,950. Pure Home Reserve puts it inside a lockable powder coated stainless steel cabinet in one of 22 colours, from $4,150. Yearly care is the same for both: $390 DIY kit, $550 yearly service, $700 Filtered for Life plan.

Q: What is the difference between an inline filter and a reverse osmosis system?
A: Pure Flow, our inline filter, uses one carbon block cartridge on the cold line of your existing mixer for particle filtration and chlorine taste and odour reduction. A reverse osmosis system adds a membrane that works at about 0.0001 micron and helps remove up to 99% of dissolved contaminants, then puts a finish back in. Our reverse osmosis systems come with their own filtered tap and a storage tank, or a filtered tap with a live purity display on Pure Luxe.

Q: What is a whole house water filter and how does it work?
A: A whole house filter connects at your property's water meter, before water reaches any tap. Every tap, shower, bath, dishwasher, washing machine and the hot water system gets filtered water. Ours run a grooved sediment cartridge, then a coconut carbon block, then a five stage carbon cartridge, filtered down to 0.22 micron. They help reduce chlorine and chloramine, as published by the manufacturer, and keep the calcium and magnesium in. Pure Home from $2,950, Pure Home Reserve from $4,150.

Q: What does 0.0001 micron mean?
A: It is the scale a reverse osmosis membrane works at, about the width of a single atom. A human hair is roughly 700,000 times wider. That is how the membrane can help remove what is dissolved in the water, which carbon on its own lets through.

Q: What is the smallest water filter system available?
A: Pure Flow uses one inline cartridge connected to the existing mixer's cold inlet. It needs no separate drinking tap and no storage tank. For a reverse osmosis system in a small cabinet, ask about Pure Luxe, which keeps five stages in one compact sealed case. Jean-Paul checks cupboard space before installation.

Q: Which systems are no longer in the range?
A: Pure Plus+, Pure Advanced, the older twin stage Pure Essential and the stainless HPF-3 whole house system are no longer in our published range. Today's Pure Essential is a 4 stage neutralising reverse osmosis system. The current range is Pure Flow, Pure Essential, Pure Premium, Pure Luxe, Pure Home and Pure Home Reserve, plus the two Deluxe packages. We still service the systems we have installed.

Q: What brands does Filters For You supply and install?
A: Our reverse osmosis range is built by Filter Systems Australia with High Performance Filtration cartridges and media, both Australian companies on the Gold Coast. Jean-Paul is an authorised installer for both. Ask about the filter taps and three way mixers we fit as well.

### SYDNEY WATER QUALITY

Q: Is Sydney tap water safe to drink?
A: Yes. Sydney Water's supply meets the Australian Drinking Water Guidelines and is safe to drink without filtering. Sydney's water is safe, but it is not pure. A filter does not make Sydney water safe, because it already is. A filter can make it taste and smell better, and our reverse osmosis systems purify the water you drink.

Q: What is in Sydney tap water?
A: Sydney tap water carries chlorine and chloramine, the disinfectants Sydney Water uses, along with naturally dissolved minerals such as calcium and magnesium and trace disinfection byproducts. All regulated parameters are within the Australian Drinking Water Guidelines.

Q: Does Sydney water contain chloramine?
A: Yes. Most of Sydney is treated with chloramine, which is chlorine combined with ammonia so the disinfectant lasts the whole way through the pipes. Unlike chlorine, chloramine does not gas off on standing or by boiling, so it is still there at your tap and in the shower. Our whole house systems help reduce chlorine and chloramine at every tap and shower, as published by the manufacturer.

Q: Does filtering Sydney water actually make a difference?
A: For taste and smell, a lot of people notice it straight away. The government's own smell limit for chloramine is half a milligram, and Sydney Water's own quarterly reports show its chloraminated supply systems running above it. That is why many people can taste it. A whole house system helps reduce chlorine and chloramine at every tap and shower. A reverse osmosis system helps remove up to 99% of dissolved contaminants in the water you drink.

---

### WHAT OUR SYSTEMS FILTER

Q: What does each Filters For You system filter?
A: Pure Flow: particle filtration through a 0.5 micron carbon block, and it helps reduce chlorine taste and odour at your kitchen mixer. Pure Essential, Pure Premium and Pure Luxe: a 0.0001 micron reverse osmosis membrane that helps remove up to 99% of dissolved contaminants, after sediment and carbon stages, then a neutral, alkaline or hydrogen rich finish. Pure Home and Pure Home Reserve: filtered down to 0.22 micron at the mains, helping reduce chlorine and chloramine at every tap and shower, as published by the manufacturer.

Q: Does a whole house system keep the minerals in?
A: Yes. Pure Home and Pure Home Reserve are chemical reduction systems, not softeners. The calcium and magnesium in your water stay in, because minerals are good.

Q: Do the reverse osmosis systems put minerals back?
A: Yes. The membrane helps remove what is dissolved, then a finish goes back in. Pure Essential adds calcium for a neutral finish, about pH 7 to 8. Pure Premium adds magnesium and potassium, raises alkalinity and introduces dissolved hydrogen. Pure Luxe adds calcium through calcite for an alkaline finish, about pH 7 to 8.

Q: What happens if I don't replace my water filter cartridges?
A: An overdue cartridge loses capacity. Flow from the filtered tap can drop and the chlorine taste and smell can come back. Change the cartridges every year.

### WATERMARK & COMPLIANCE

Q: What is WaterMark certification for water filters?
A: WaterMark is Australia's mandatory certification for plumbing products. Products connected to a building's drinking water supply must carry it. A WaterMark certified water treatment system has been tested by an accredited body, for example to AS 3497:2021, and is listed on the public register run by the Australian Building Codes Board. It is a plumbing approval, not a health claim.

Q: Are Filters For You systems WaterMark certified?
A: Our reverse osmosis systems carry WaterMark certification under certificate 23247, AS 3497:2021, valid to 3 October 2028. Their filtration media is manufactured in compliance with NSF/ANSI standards, the international standards for water treatment. The certificates are published at https://filtersforyou.com.au/watermark-certified-water-filter-sydney.

Q: Are all water filters WaterMark certified?
A: No. Not every water filter sold in Australia carries WaterMark. Anything connected to a building's drinking water supply needs it, so check the WaterMark register for the model before you buy.

Q: Does WaterMark certification guarantee filtration performance?
A: No. WaterMark confirms a product meets Australian standards for materials and design and is fit to connect to drinking water. What a system filters is set out by the manufacturer. Jean-Paul explains what each system does before installation.

Q: Is NSF certification the same as WaterMark?
A: No, they cover different things. WaterMark is the Australian plumbing approval. NSF/ANSI standards are international standards for filter media. The filtration media in our reverse osmosis range is manufactured in compliance with NSF/ANSI standards. NSF is not an Australian legal requirement and never replaces WaterMark.

Q: Does water filter installation require a licensed plumber in NSW?
A: Yes. Connecting a water filter to the mains water supply is plumbing work in NSW and needs a licensed plumber. Jean-Paul holds NSW Plumbing Licence #461511C.

Q: How do I verify Jean-Paul's plumbing licence?
A: Jean-Paul's licence number is 461511C. Search it at fair.trading.nsw.gov.au to check it is current. It is printed on the website beside the NSW badge.

### SYSTEM COMPARISONS

Q: What is the difference between whole house and under sink water filtration?
A: A whole house system (Pure Home from $2,950, Pure Home Reserve from $4,150) sits at the mains, so every tap, shower, bath and appliance runs filtered. An under sink system (Pure Flow $760, reverse osmosis from $1,090) works on the water at the kitchen sink. Whole house suits houses with their own water meter. Under sink works for houses and apartments. Many Sydney homes choose both, which is what the Deluxe packages are.

Q: What is the difference between under sink and benchtop water filters?
A: Under sink filters mount inside the kitchen cabinet and connect to the cold water line, with filtered water through your mixer or a dedicated tap on the bench. Benchtop filters sit on the counter and connect to the existing tap with a diverter, with no installation. Benchtop is a portable option for renters who cannot make any changes.

Q: Should I choose an inline carbon filter or a reverse osmosis system?
A: Pure Flow uses a single carbon block cartridge for particle filtration and chlorine taste and odour reduction, on your existing mixer. Pure Essential, Pure Premium and Pure Luxe add a 0.0001 micron membrane that helps remove up to 99% of dissolved contaminants, then a neutral, alkaline or hydrogen rich finish. Choose by the treatment and the tap arrangement you want.

Q: Is a whole house filter better than a reverse osmosis system?
A: They do different jobs. Whole house filters at the mains: filtered down to 0.22 micron, helping reduce chlorine and chloramine in every shower and tap, with the minerals kept in. Reverse osmosis purifies at the kitchen, through a membrane about 700,000 times finer than a hair, and helps remove up to 99% of dissolved contaminants in the water you drink. Choose whole house when every shower and tap matters. Choose reverse osmosis when it is about the drinking glass, you rent, or the budget is tighter. Have one, or have both.

Q: Why add reverse osmosis to a whole house system?
A: Two reasons. A second, different kind of purification on the water you drink, because the membrane works on what is dissolved. And a finish you choose at the glass: neutral with Pure Essential, hydrogen rich alkaline with Pure Premium, or alkaline with Pure Luxe. Filtered at every tap, purified in every glass. That is the thinking behind the Deluxe packages.

Q: Why choose Filters For You over other Sydney water filter companies?
A: A licensed plumber installs every system. Every installed price and every yearly care price is published, and your price is in writing before we start. The Filtered for Life plan carries a lifetime warranty on parts, labour and call outs for as long as you stay on it. NSW Licensed Plumber #461511C. Authorised Filter Systems Australia and High Performance Filtration installer. 5.0 from 33 Google reviews, every one five stars (as at 19 October 2026).
